parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: Ephemeral
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the node is an ephemeral node. Valid values:

*   `true`: yes
*   `false`: no

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Nacos instance.

parameters.name: Ip
parameters.description: The IP address of the Nacos instance.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port of the Nacos instance.
